RULE 5 : Validated-but-stale: armed (ai_validating) + validation concluded but BASE MOVED (BEHIND only). BLOCKED must NOT unarm: since #483 BLOCKED is a real verdict, and on a freshly armed head BLOCKED simply means 'required checks pending' — unarming there races validate-armed in the SAME tick and deadlocks the PR forever (live: fa pr-762 armed at 08:25:37, unarmed 08:25:58 by the BLOCKED match, re-armed next tick, loop). silent-update-behind excludes ai_validating and merge-validated needs CLEAN, so without this unarm a genuinely moved base still deadlocks (live: fa pr-744) — BEHIND-only keeps that recovery and stops the self-inflicted one. gh-751 VERDICT-AWARE STRIP (live: fa #1295 — the arm was stripped FIVE times in one day with zero latches, [ai_validating]→[]→[ai_validating] yo-yo under a saturated CI queue): every main merge made the armed head BEHIND and this strip DISCARDED the head's ALREADY-CONCLUDED green verdict — it lost the race to the strip (merge-validated needs CLEAN; validated-green sits later and excludes pr_approved), silent-update refreshed, validate-fresh re-armed, the next merge re-struck: a full re-validation per main merge. The action now probes the head's dispatched validation runs before stripping: a GREEN run ANYWHERE on the head latches ai_validated instead of the bare unarm — not only the newest run: gh-748 showed two workflow_dispatch runs landing on ONE head seconds apart, and the latch consumer (validate-armed's skipIfValidatedHead → hasSuccessfulDispatchedRun) accepts any completed-green run on the head, so the strip consumes that same facet (complete_validation parity — sweep_stale_validation's success-branch shape; the latch excludes the PR from validate-fresh, and validate-armed latch-skips on the unchanged head so the merge window re-flows without new CI); only when NO green run exists on the head (red / absent / in-flight / cancelled-only) does the bare unarm stand (refresh + re-validate recovery).

RULE 13 : Post-approval merge window — OWNER FIFO RULE (2026-09-22): lead the OLDEST approved PR all the way to merge; never validate other approved PRs meanwhile (the merge moves the base — they would re-validate anyway). Advance to the next approved ONLY when the oldest is DIRTY (conflict-rework owns it) or its validation went RED (rework leg fixes it) — both free this slot while the oldest repairs. BEHIND/DIRTY excluded here: silent-update refreshes BEHIND heads first; conflicted heads can never reach CLEAN. Mutex ai_validating = one validation at a time; the action re-verifies that mutex at ARM time on a LIVE list (owner directive 2026-10-04, live fa 12:0x: #1194 + #1215 both armed after a manual strip — the query-time scan read the stale cached list). RED YIELDS THE SLOT (owner directive 2026-10-04): a candidate whose CURRENT head SHA already went red redHeadCap (default 3) times — counted from the 🔴 markers on its fail reports — is SKIPPED until a NEW head lands; jobParams.redHeadSkip=false disables. validation_failed excluded (owner 2026-09-27, live: fa#923 — a GUEST PR whose head went red cycles arm→CI red→silent-update→re-arm forever, holding this limit-1 slot hostage; the silent-update action labels such guests validation_failed and they stay parked until a NON-MACHINE push moves the head). PRIORITY TIERS (owner directive 2026-10-08, amends the 2026-09-22 FIFO rule): the approved queue is FIFO WITHIN a tier — priority_blocker PREEMPTS (a younger blocker takes this arm slot and the ai_validating mutex ahead of older mediums; the limit-1 pick is tier-aware in queryPrs and logs a 🥇 line per preemption), priority_low SINKS below all mediums, and a PR with NO priority label is medium (the priority_medium label is NOT required to exist). The label carrier is the PR itself OR its linked issue — either counts (issue labels resolved via github_get_issue, per-tick cached). Label NAMES are configurable per project via .dmtools/config.js smPriorityLabels (defaults blocker/medium/low = priority_blocker/priority_medium/priority_low; absent mapping entries degrade to the defaults). gh-837 PARALLEL VALIDATIONS (merge-cadence goal; option chosen over merge-train and validation wall-time cut): jobParams.validationConcurrency (default 1 = today's strictly serial behavior) relaxes this mutex to admit up to N CONCURRENT approved-arm validations when the approved queue depth is at/above jobParams.validationConcurrencyQueueWatermark (default 3) — the SM patches query.mutexMax on this rule (and the revalidate-armed/-green twins) per tick, githubSource defers new arms only once OTHER holders reach the cap, and the validate_pr action-time re-check counts against the same number. Runner cost is hard-capped at N x validationMinutesEstimate (default 35) and reported per tick (AC2). # Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot]'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

Runner cost is hard-capped at N x validationMinutesEstimate (default 35) and reported per tick (AC2). A red validation still parks exactly one head — fail-validation is per-PR, the parallel arms share no state (AC3, #832 semantics preserved). # Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot]'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

RULE 5 : Validated-but-stale: armed (ai_validating) + validation concluded but BASE MOVED (BEHIND only). BLOCKED must NOT unarm: since #483 BLOCKED is a real verdict, and on a freshly armed head BLOCKED simply means 'required checks pending' — unarming there races validate-armed in the SAME tick and deadlocks the PR forever (live: fa pr-762 armed at 08:25:37, unarmed 08:25:58 by the BLOCKED match, re-armed next tick, loop). silent-update-behind excludes ai_validating and merge-validated needs CLEAN, so without this unarm a genuinely moved base still deadlocks (live: fa pr-744) — BEHIND-only keeps that recovery and stops the self-inflicted one. gh-751 VERDICT-AWARE STRIP (live: fa #1295 — the arm was stripped FIVE times in one day with zero latches, [ai_validating]→[]→[ai_validating] yo-yo under a saturated CI queue): every main merge made the armed head BEHIND and this strip DISCARDED the head's ALREADY-CONCLUDED green verdict — it lost the race to the strip (merge-validated needs CLEAN; validated-green sits later and excludes pr_approved), silent-update refreshed, validate-fresh re-armed, the next merge re-struck: a full re-validation per main merge. The action now probes the head's dispatched validation runs before stripping: a GREEN run ANYWHERE on the head latches ai_validated instead of the bare unarm — not only the newest run: gh-748 showed two workflow_dispatch runs landing on ONE head seconds apart, and the latch consumer (validate-armed's skipIfValidatedHead → hasSuccessfulDispatchedRun) accepts any completed-green run on the head, so the strip consumes that same facet (complete_validation parity — sweep_stale_validation's success-branch shape; the latch excludes the PR from validate-fresh, and validate-armed latch-skips on the unchanged head so the merge window re-flows without new CI); only when NO green run exists on the head (red / absent / in-flight / cancelled-only) does the bare unarm stand (refresh + re-validate recovery).

Advance to the next approved ONLY when the oldest is DIRTY (conflict-rework owns it) or its validation went RED (rework leg fixes it) — both free this slot while the oldest repairs. BEHIND/DIRTY excluded here: silent-update refreshes BEHIND heads first; conflicted heads can never reach CLEAN. Mutex ai_validating = one validation at a time; the action re-verifies that mutex at ARM time on a LIVE list (owner directive 2026-10-04, live fa 12:0x: #1194 + #1215 both armed after a manual strip — the query-time scan read the stale cached list). RED YIELDS THE SLOT (owner directive 2026-10-04): a candidate whose CURRENT head SHA already went red redHeadCap (default 3) times — counted from the 🔴 markers on its fail reports — is SKIPPED until a NEW head lands; jobParams.redHeadSkip=false disables. validation_failed excluded (owner 2026-09-27, live: fa#923 — a GUEST PR whose head went red cycles arm→CI red→silent-update→re-arm forever, holding this limit-1 slot hostage; the silent-update action labels such guests validation_failed and they stay parked until a NON-MACHINE push moves the head). PRIORITY TIERS (owner directive 2026-10-08, amends the 2026-09-22 FIFO rule): the approved queue is FIFO WITHIN a tier — priority_blocker PREEMPTS (a younger blocker takes this arm slot and the ai_validating mutex ahead of older mediums; the limit-1 pick is tier-aware in queryPrs and logs a 🥇 line per preemption), priority_low SINKS below all mediums, and a PR with NO priority label is medium (the priority_medium label is NOT required to exist). The label carrier is the PR itself OR its linked issue — either counts (issue labels resolved via github_get_issue, per-tick cached). Label NAMES are configurable per project via .dmtools/config.js smPriorityLabels (defaults blocker/medium/low = priority_blocker/priority_medium/priority_low; absent mapping entries degrade to the defaults). gh-837 PARALLEL VALIDATIONS (merge-cadence goal; option chosen over merge-train and validation wall-time cut): jobParams.validationConcurrency (default 1 = today's strictly serial behavior) relaxes this mutex to admit up to N CONCURRENT approved-arm validations when the approved queue depth is at/above jobParams.validationConcurrencyQueueWatermark (default 3) — the SM patches query.mutexMax on this rule (and the revalidate-armed/-green twins) per tick, githubSource defers new arms only once OTHER holders reach the cap, and the validate_pr action-time re-check counts against the same number. Runner cost is hard-capped at N x validationMinutesEstimate (default 35) and reported per tick (AC2). A red validation still parks exactly one head — fail-validation is per-PR, the parallel arms share no state (AC3, #832 semantics preserved). The dev lane (mutexAmong [pr_approved]) is untouched: only approved arms widen. The arm limit also rises to the cap (limit N) so every free slot fills in ONE tick — with a limit-1 arm the second validation dispatches a tick behind the first, concludes after the first merge, and its run is wasted (BEHIND); simultaneous arms conclude together and the mergeBot's one-run batch (it merges EVERY green + CLEAN approved head per run) lands them in a single window (L2 replay, test_mergeCadence: serial ~50 min/merge -> parallel-2 ~25 min/merge at queue depth 6, sustained <=30 target met; the owner's 1/hour floor holds even at N=2 with one lost batch). gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID (the unarmed twin of the #1457 ghost shape: pr_approved + ai_validated + green dispatched run + green rollup, but zombie in_progress check-runs hold mergeState BLOCKED — arming WITHOUT a dispatch would deadlock forever since merge-validated needs CLEAN and no run is ever ordered to override the ghosts): when the head carries check-run zombies (js/common/checkRunZombies.js), validate_pr voids the latch-skip and dispatches a real validation instead.

# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot]'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot]'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot]'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot]'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot]'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot]'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

BLOCKED must NOT unarm: since #483 BLOCKED is a real verdict, and on a freshly armed head BLOCKED simply means 'required checks pending' — unarming there races validate-armed in the SAME tick and deadlocks the PR forever (live: fa pr-762 armed at 08:25:37, unarmed 08:25:58 by the BLOCKED match, re-armed next tick, loop). silent-update-behind excludes ai_validating and merge-validated needs CLEAN, so without this unarm a genuinely moved base still deadlocks (live: fa pr-744) — BEHIND-only keeps that recovery and stops the self-inflicted one. gh-751 VERDICT-AWARE STRIP (live: fa #1295 — the arm was stripped FIVE times in one day with zero latches, [ai_validating]→[]→[ai_validating] yo-yo under a saturated CI queue): every main merge made the armed head BEHIND and this strip DISCARDED the head's ALREADY-CONCLUDED green verdict — it lost the race to the strip (merge-validated needs CLEAN; validated-green sits later and excludes pr_approved), silent-update refreshed, validate-fresh re-armed, the next merge re-struck: a full re-validation per main merge. # Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot]'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot]'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot]'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot]'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

RULE 5 : Validated-but-stale: armed (ai_validating) + validation concluded but BASE MOVED (BEHIND only). BLOCKED must NOT unarm: since #483 BLOCKED is a real verdict, and on a freshly armed head BLOCKED simply means 'required checks pending' — unarming there races validate-armed in the SAME tick and deadlocks the PR forever (live: fa pr-762 armed at 08:25:37, unarmed 08:25:58 by the BLOCKED match, re-armed next tick, loop). silent-update-behind excludes ai_validating and merge-validated needs CLEAN, so without this unarm a genuinely moved base still deadlocks (live: fa pr-744) — BEHIND-only keeps that recovery and stops the self-inflicted one. gh-751 VERDICT-AWARE STRIP (live: fa #1295 — the arm was stripped FIVE times in one day with zero latches, [ai_validating]→[]→[ai_validating] yo-yo under a saturated CI queue): every main merge made the armed head BEHIND and this strip DISCARDED the head's ALREADY-CONCLUDED green verdict — it lost the race to the strip (merge-validated needs CLEAN; validated-green sits later and excludes pr_approved), silent-update refreshed, validate-fresh re-armed, the next merge re-struck: a full re-validation per main merge. The action now probes the head's dispatched validation runs before stripping: a GREEN run ANYWHERE on the head latches ai_validated instead of the bare unarm — not only the newest run: gh-748 showed two workflow_dispatch runs landing on ONE head seconds apart, and the latch consumer (validate-armed's skipIfValidatedHead → hasSuccessfulDispatchedRun) accepts any completed-green run on the head, so the strip consumes that same facet (complete_validation parity — sweep_stale_validation's success-branch shape; the latch excludes the PR from validate-fresh, and validate-armed latch-skips on the unchanged head so the merge window re-flows without new CI); only when NO green run exists on the head (red / absent / in-flight / cancelled-only) does the bare unarm stand (refresh + re-validate recovery).

RULE 13 : Post-approval merge window — OWNER FIFO RULE (2026-09-22): lead the OLDEST approved PR all the way to merge; never validate other approved PRs meanwhile (the merge moves the base — they would re-validate anyway). Advance to the next approved ONLY when the oldest is DIRTY (conflict-rework owns it) or its validation went RED (rework leg fixes it) — both free this slot while the oldest repairs. BEHIND/DIRTY excluded here: silent-update refreshes BEHIND heads first; conflicted heads can never reach CLEAN. Mutex ai_validating = one validation at a time; the action re-verifies that mutex at ARM time on a LIVE list (owner directive 2026-10-04, live fa 12:0x: #1194 + #1215 both armed after a manual strip — the query-time scan read the stale cached list). RED YIELDS THE SLOT (owner directive 2026-10-04): a candidate whose CURRENT head SHA already went red redHeadCap (default 3) times — counted from the 🔴 markers on its fail reports — is SKIPPED until a NEW head lands; jobParams.redHeadSkip=false disables. validation_failed excluded (owner 2026-09-27, live: fa#923 — a GUEST PR whose head went red cycles arm→CI red→silent-update→re-arm forever, holding this limit-1 slot hostage; the silent-update action labels such guests validation_failed and they stay parked until a NON-MACHINE push moves the head). PRIORITY TIERS (owner directive 2026-10-08, amends the 2026-09-22 FIFO rule): the approved queue is FIFO WITHIN a tier — priority_blocker PREEMPTS (a younger blocker takes this arm slot and the ai_validating mutex ahead of older mediums; the limit-1 pick is tier-aware in queryPrs and logs a 🥇 line per preemption), priority_low SINKS below all mediums, and a PR with NO priority label is medium (the priority_medium label is NOT required to exist). The label carrier is the PR itself OR its linked issue — either counts (issue labels resolved via github_get_issue, per-tick cached). Label NAMES are configurable per project via .dmtools/config.js smPriorityLabels (defaults blocker/medium/low = priority_blocker/priority_medium/priority_low; absent mapping entries degrade to the defaults). gh-837 PARALLEL VALIDATIONS (merge-cadence goal; option chosen over merge-train and validation wall-time cut): jobParams.validationConcurrency (default 1 = today's strictly serial behavior) relaxes this mutex to admit up to N CONCURRENT approved-arm validations when the approved queue depth is at/above jobParams.validationConcurrencyQueueWatermark (default 3) — the SM patches query.mutexMax on this rule (and the revalidate-armed/-green twins) per tick, githubSource defers new arms only once OTHER holders reach the cap, and the validate_pr action-time re-check counts against the same number. Runner cost is hard-capped at N x validationMinutesEstimate (default 35) and reported per tick (AC2). A red validation still parks exactly one head — fail-validation is per-PR, the parallel arms share no state (AC3, #832 semantics preserved). The dev lane (mutexAmong [pr_approved]) is untouched: only approved arms widen. The arm limit also rises to the cap (limit N) so every free slot fills in ONE tick — with a limit-1 arm the second validation dispatches a tick behind the first, concludes after the first merge, and its run is wasted (BEHIND); simultaneous arms conclude together and the mergeBot's one-run batch (it merges EVERY green + CLEAN approved head per run) lands them in a single window (L2 replay, test_mergeCadence: serial ~50 min/merge -> parallel-2 ~25 min/merge at queue depth 6, sustained <=30 target met; the owner's 1/hour floor holds even at N=2 with one lost batch). gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID (the unarmed twin of the #1457 ghost shape: pr_approved + ai_validated + green dispatched run + green rollup, but zombie in_progress check-runs hold mergeState BLOCKED — arming WITHOUT a dispatch would deadlock forever since merge-validated needs CLEAN and no run is ever ordered to override the ghosts): when the head carries check-run zombies (js/common/checkRunZombies.js), validate_pr voids the latch-skip and dispatches a real validation instead.

====================================================================================================
RULE 5 : Validated-but-stale: armed (ai_validating) + validation concluded but BASE MOVED (BEHIND only). BLOCKED must NOT unarm: since #483 BLOCKED is a real verdict, and on a freshly armed head BLOCKED simply means 'required checks pending' — unarming there races validate-armed in the SAME tick and deadlocks the PR forever (live: fa pr-762 armed at 08:25:37, unarmed 08:25:58 by the BLOCKED match, re-armed next tick, loop). silent-update-behind excludes ai_validating and merge-validated needs CLEAN, so without this unarm a genuinely moved base still deadlocks (live: fa pr-744) — BEHIND-only keeps that recovery and stops the self-inflicted one. gh-751 VERDICT-AWARE STRIP (live: fa #1295 — the arm was stripped FIVE times in one day with zero latches, [ai_validating]→[]→[ai_validating] yo-yo under a saturated CI queue): every main merge made the armed head BEHIND and this strip DISCARDED the head's ALREADY-CONCLUDED green verdict — it lost the race to the strip (merge-validated needs CLEAN; validated-green sits later and excludes pr_approved), silent-update refreshed, validate-fresh re-armed, the next merge re-struck: a full re-validation per main merge. The action now probes the head's dispatched validation runs before stripping: a GREEN run ANYWHERE on the head latches ai_validated instead of the bare unarm — not only the newest run: gh-748 showed two workflow_dispatch runs landing on ONE head seconds apart, and the latch consumer (validate-armed's skipIfValidatedHead → hasSuccessfulDispatchedRun) accepts any completed-green run on the head, so the strip consumes that same facet (complete_validation parity — sweep_stale_validation's success-branch shape; the latch excludes the PR from validate-fresh, and validate-armed latch-skips on the unchanged head so the merge window re-flows without new CI); only when NO green run exists on the head (red / absent / in-flight / cancelled-only) does the bare unarm stand (refresh + re-validate recovery).

 "source": "github",
 "query": {
  "type": "pr",
  "labels": [
   "ai_validating"
  ],
  "mergeState": [
   "BEHIND"
  ],
  "draft": false
 },
 "localAction": "unarm_validation",
 "limit": 1,
 "id": "unarm-stale-validation"
}
====================================================================================================
RULE 13 : Post-approval merge window — OWNER FIFO RULE (2026-09-22): lead the OLDEST approved PR all the way to merge; never validate other approved PRs meanwhile (the merge moves the base — they would re-validate anyway). Advance to the next approved ONLY when the oldest is DIRTY (conflict-rework owns it) or its validation went RED (rework leg fixes it) — both free this slot while the oldest repairs. BEHIND/DIRTY excluded here: silent-update refreshes BEHIND heads first; conflicted heads can never reach CLEAN. Mutex ai_validating = one validation at a time; the action re-verifies that mutex at ARM time on a LIVE list (owner directive 2026-10-04, live fa 12:0x: #1194 + #1215 both armed after a manual strip — the query-time scan read the stale cached list). RED YIELDS THE SLOT (owner directive 2026-10-04): a candidate whose CURRENT head SHA already went red redHeadCap (default 3) times — counted from the 🔴 markers on its fail reports — is SKIPPED until a NEW head lands; jobParams.redHeadSkip=false disables. validation_failed excluded (owner 2026-09-27, live: fa#923 — a GUEST PR whose head went red cycles arm→CI red→silent-update→re-arm forever, holding this limit-1 slot hostage; the silent-update action labels such guests validation_failed and they stay parked until a NON-MACHINE push moves the head). PRIORITY TIERS (owner directive 2026-10-08, amends the 2026-09-22 FIFO rule): the approved queue is FIFO WITHIN a tier — priority_blocker PREEMPTS (a younger blocker takes this arm slot and the ai_validating mutex ahead of older mediums; the limit-1 pick is tier-aware in queryPrs and logs a 🥇 line per preemption), priority_low SINKS below all mediums, and a PR with NO priority label is medium (the priority_medium label is NOT required to exist). The label carrier is the PR itself OR its linked issue — either counts (issue labels resolved via github_get_issue, per-tick cached). Label NAMES are configurable per project via .dmtools/config.js smPriorityLabels (defaults blocker/medium/low = priority_blocker/priority_medium/priority_low; absent mapping entries degrade to the defaults). gh-837 PARALLEL VALIDATIONS (merge-cadence goal; option chosen over merge-train and validation wall-time cut): jobParams.validationConcurrency (default 1 = today's strictly serial behavior) relaxes this mutex to admit up to N CONCURRENT approved-arm validations when the approved queue depth is at/above jobParams.validationConcurrencyQueueWatermark (default 3) — the SM patches query.mutexMax on this rule (and the revalidate-armed/-green twins) per tick, githubSource defers new arms only once OTHER holders reach the cap, and the validate_pr action-time re-check counts against the same number. Runner cost is hard-capped at N x validationMinutesEstimate (default 35) and reported per tick (AC2). A red validation still parks exactly one head — fail-validation is per-PR, the parallel arms share no state (AC3, #832 semantics preserved). The dev lane (mutexAmong [pr_approved]) is untouched: only approved arms widen. The arm limit also rises to the cap (limit N) so every free slot fills in ONE tick — with a limit-1 arm the second validation dispatches a tick behind the first, concludes after the first merge, and its run is wasted (BEHIND); simultaneous arms conclude together and the mergeBot's one-run batch (it merges EVERY green + CLEAN approved head per run) lands them in a single window (L2 replay, test_mergeCadence: serial ~50 min/merge -> parallel-2 ~25 min/merge at queue depth 6, sustained <=30 target met; the owner's 1/hour floor holds even at N=2 with one lost batch). gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID (the unarmed twin of the #1457 ghost shape: pr_approved + ai_validated + green dispatched run + green rollup, but zombie in_progress check-runs hold mergeState BLOCKED — arming WITHOUT a dispatch would deadlock forever since merge-validated needs CLEAN and no run is ever ordered to override the ghosts): when the head carries check-run zombies (js/common/checkRunZombies.js), validate_pr voids the latch-skip and dispatches a real validation instead.

RULE 5 : Validated-but-stale: armed (ai_validating) + validation concluded but BASE MOVED (BEHIND only). BLOCKED must NOT unarm: since #483 BLOCKED is a real verdict, and on a freshly armed head BLOCKED simply means 'required checks pending' — unarming there races validate-armed in the SAME tick and deadlocks the PR forever (live: fa pr-762 armed at 08:25:37, unarmed 08:25:58 by the BLOCKED match, re-armed next tick, loop). silent-update-behind excludes ai_validating and merge-validated needs CLEAN, so without this unarm a genuinely moved base still deadlocks (live: fa pr-744) — BEHIND-only keeps that recovery and stops the self-inflicted one. gh-751 VERDICT-AWARE STRIP (live: fa #1295 — the arm was stripped FIVE times in one day with zero latches, [ai_validating]→[]→[ai_validating] yo-yo under a saturated CI queue): every main merge made the armed head BEHIND and this strip DISCARDED the head's ALREADY-CONCLUDED green verdict — it lost the race to the strip (merge-validated needs CLEAN; validated-green sits later and excludes pr_approved), silent-update refreshed, validate-fresh re-armed, the next merge re-struck: a full re-validation per main merge. The action now probes the head's dispatched validation runs before stripping: a GREEN run ANYWHERE on the head latches ai_validated instead of the bare unarm — not only the newest run: gh-748 showed two workflow_dispatch runs landing on ONE head seconds apart, and the latch consumer (validate-armed's skipIfValidatedHead → hasSuccessfulDispatchedRun) accepts any completed-green run on the head, so the strip consumes that same facet (complete_validation parity — sweep_stale_validation's success-branch shape; the latch excludes the PR from validate-fresh, and validate-armed latch-skips on the unchanged head so the merge window re-flows without new CI); only when NO green run exists on the head (red / absent / in-flight / cancelled-only) does the bare unarm stand (refresh + re-validate recovery).

RULE 13 : Post-approval merge window — OWNER FIFO RULE (2026-09-22): lead the OLDEST approved PR all the way to merge; never validate other approved PRs meanwhile (the merge moves the base — they would re-validate anyway). Advance to the next approved ONLY when the oldest is DIRTY (conflict-rework owns it) or its validation went RED (rework leg fixes it) — both free this slot while the oldest repairs. BEHIND/DIRTY excluded here: silent-update refreshes BEHIND heads first; conflicted heads can never reach CLEAN. Mutex ai_validating = one validation at a time; the action re-verifies that mutex at ARM time on a LIVE list (owner directive 2026-10-04, live fa 12:0x: #1194 + #1215 both armed after a manual strip — the query-time scan read the stale cached list). RED YIELDS THE SLOT (owner directive 2026-10-04): a candidate whose CURRENT head SHA already went red redHeadCap (default 3) times — counted from the 🔴 markers on its fail reports — is SKIPPED until a NEW head lands; jobParams.redHeadSkip=false disables. validation_failed excluded (owner 2026-09-27, live: fa#923 — a GUEST PR whose head went red cycles arm→CI red→silent-update→re-arm forever, holding this limit-1 slot hostage; the silent-update action labels such guests validation_failed and they stay parked until a NON-MACHINE push moves the head). PRIORITY TIERS (owner directive 2026-10-08, amends the 2026-09-22 FIFO rule): the approved queue is FIFO WITHIN a tier — priority_blocker PREEMPTS (a younger blocker takes this arm slot and the ai_validating mutex ahead of older mediums; the limit-1 pick is tier-aware in queryPrs and logs a 🥇 line per preemption), priority_low SINKS below all mediums, and a PR with NO priority label is medium (the priority_medium label is NOT required to exist). The label carrier is the PR itself OR its linked issue — either counts (issue labels resolved via github_get_issue, per-tick cached). Label NAMES are configurable per project via .dmtools/config.js smPriorityLabels (defaults blocker/medium/low = priority_blocker/priority_medium/priority_low; absent mapping entries degrade to the defaults). gh-837 PARALLEL VALIDATIONS (merge-cadence goal; option chosen over merge-train and validation wall-time cut): jobParams.validationConcurrency (default 1 = today's strictly serial behavior) relaxes this mutex to admit up to N CONCURRENT approved-arm validations when the approved queue depth is at/above jobParams.validationConcurrencyQueueWatermark (default 3) — the SM patches query.mutexMax on this rule (and the revalidate-armed/-green twins) per tick, githubSource defers new arms only once OTHER holders reach the cap, and the validate_pr action-time re-check counts against the same number. Runner cost is hard-capped at N x validationMinutesEstimate (default 35) and reported per tick (AC2). A red validation still parks exactly one head — fail-validation is per-PR, the parallel arms share no state (AC3, #832 semantics preserved). The dev lane (mutexAmong [pr_approved]) is untouched: only approved arms widen. The arm limit also rises to the cap (limit N) so every free slot fills in ONE tick — with a limit-1 arm the second validation dispatches a tick behind the first, concludes after the first merge, and its run is wasted (BEHIND); simultaneous arms conclude together and the mergeBot's one-run batch (it merges EVERY green + CLEAN approved head per run) lands them in a single window (L2 replay, test_mergeCadence: serial ~50 min/merge -> parallel-2 ~25 min/merge at queue depth 6, sustained <=30 target met; the owner's 1/hour floor holds even at N=2 with one lost batch). gh-842 LATCH-SKIP VOID (the unarmed twin of the #1457 ghost shape: pr_approved + ai_validated + green dispatched run + green rollup, but zombie in_progress check-runs hold mergeState BLOCKED — arming WITHOUT a dispatch would deadlock forever since merge-validated needs CLEAN and no run is ever ordered to override the ghosts): when the head carries check-run zombies (js/common/checkRunZombies.js), validate_pr voids the latch-skip and dispatches a real validation instead.

There's only ONE commit in history — the whole repo was squashed into `ff282f2`. So there's no granular history to learn from.

OK. Decision time. Let me carefully identify where the gh-952 fix belongs, from the incident mechanics:

**Incident chain:**
1. #1661 armed (ai_validating + pending validation stamps) → owner merged externally at 06:30Z → the machine's merge path never ran → the arm NEVER got a "consumed" event (no merge action by the machine, no unarm, nothing).
2. #1661 gone from open list → no open armed PR → merge bot defers all approved PRs → self-tick → SM.
3. The SM — 4+ ticks — never arms anyone.

**Why doesn't the SM arm?** Candidates:
(a1) The SM's global concurrency gate (machineSmAgent: `activeMachineRuns >= maxConcurrentRuns`) held by a zombie/orphaned run for the merged #1661. 
(a2) The SM's validate-armed arm path held by stale bookkeeping.

Now — which SM does the fa machine loop run? Look at `.github/workflows/machine-sm.yml` in THIS repo — it's the machine loop's SM for THIS repo, delegating to the frozen factory. And the fa product repo has its own machine-sm.yml. The frozen factory (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows) runs the pack code from THIS repo's releases — machineSmAgent.js is THIS repo's module ("Machine SM Agent — GitHub-issues machine-loop watchdog (JSRunner)"). It's extremely likely factory-sm.yml runs `js/machineSmAgent.js` from the agents pack.

So the machineSmAgent + smProvider.activeMachineRuns is the "slot bookkeeping" for the machine loop:

Now let me ALSO nail down the merge-bot (a) implementation. Let me re-examine the bot's slot logic one more and design the precise change:

In `mergeBot.action`:
- Slot bookkeeping = who holds the validate-armed turn (an open armed approved PR) + the dead-head chain (`deadHeadPassed`).
- After an external merge of the slot-holder, the open list has no armed PR. Today: all approved defer; acted 0; self-tick fires. The TICKET says the slot must RELEASE — the bot must detect the merged holder (evidence: a MERGED PR still carrying the merge-window arm labels — `ai_validating` + `pr_approved`, i.e. "the armed stamps belong to a merged PR") and RELEASE: log it, and treat the head position as vacated — `deadHeadPassed = true` — so a validated approved candidate may advance on existing evidence (gh-766 machinery) and the queue visibly advances past the released slot.

Where to probe: BEFORE the FIFO loop (the release must be visible to the first candidate). Condition: no open PR carries the merge-window arm (ai_validating + pr_approved) — the slot looks free-but-unconsumed; at least one approved PR exists. Then ONE `github_list_prs({state:'merged', perPage: 30})` call; if any returned PR carries both labels → that's the released slot-holder.

Behavior on detection:
1. Log: `🔓 pr-N held the merge-window slot but is MERGED — slot released (armed stamps belonged to a merged PR)`.
2. `deadHeadPassed = true` for the loop (the gh-766 advance path can merge an approved+ai_validated+green+CLEAN candidate).

Also the self-tick still fires (deferredApproved && acted===0) so the SM arms the next head — unchanged.

Edge: the merged list includes OLD merged PRs forever — could a months-old merged PR with lingering labels keep setting deadHeadPassed every run? Harmless for correctness (the release is idempotent; the advance is gated on a live validated candidate), but the log spam would recur. Bound it: only count holders merged within the last 24h (`closed_at`/`merged_at` recent) — a release notice for the CURRENT incident, not archaeology. But deadHeadPassed itself: keep it unconditional? If a merged armed PR from 3 weeks ago exists (stale labels linger), the release log would fire on EVERY bot run — noisy. I'll gate BOTH the log and the deadHeadPassed on the recency window (24h, configurable via jobParams.mergedSlotHolderWindowMinutes? — keep it simple: 24h constant... hmm, prefer a jobParam with default). Actually — the bot has staleHeadMinutes as a jobParam precedent. I'll add `mergedHolderHours` default 24. Hmm, or simpler: no knob, 24h constant, documented. Given the repo's style (lots of knobs), a jobParam is in-character. I'll do `mergedSlotHolderHours` default 24.

Wait — one more consideration on the merged probe: `github_list_prs` with `state: 'merged'` — does the bridge support it? smProvider.listMergedPrs uses `state: 'merged'` — yes, supported.

Sorting: merged list newest-first (API default) — fine, take the first match.

Now — the labels on the merged PR: `github_list_prs(state:'merged')` returns labels per PR (REST list body includes labels). Good.

1. **mergeBot merged-holder release** — the ticket's named component. MUST.
2. **smAgent stale-label cleanup (b)** — the actual arming recovery. MUST.

SHOULD — this is literally "(a) the slot bookkeeping must detect the slot-holder PR is MERGED and release" for the machine SM tick. I'll implement it — it directly matches (a)'s wording, and the gate is the machine SM's OWN slot bookkeeping.

The fa loop: "dev → PR → CI → rework → AI review → merge → close" with legs dev/review/rework — machineSmAgent dispatches legs; VALIDATION arming (ai_validating) is smAgent/githubSource + mergeBot vocabulary... BUT the machineSmAgent DOES merge approved PRs and its decideActions knows pr_approved/ai_pr_reviewed! And its gate `activeMachineRuns` → idle. Hmm — BOTH agents coexist in the frozen factory (factory-sm.yml probably runs machineSmAgent; the PR-lifecycle rules run through smAgent with the sm_github.json-style rules; the mergeBot is event-driven). Path analysis in update_branch (rule 12 park-reset routes here; rule 11 too):
- `headChangedNoVerdictVf`: requires `parkedHeadVf` (park-comment sha) non-null and non-empty and ≠ uHead. `parkedHeadSha` returns '' when no park comment carries 'parked-head: <40hex>'. The STICKY-PARK SET comment (from silent-update's park set) DOES include 'parked-head: <sha>'... The SET path comment: "🛑 validation_failed — ... parked-head: ' + uHead" — includes it. Line 3560-3570 area. Also the zombie-crash-loop park (line 3299). If the park was set by a comment WITHOUT the sha marker, parkedHeadSha returns '' → headChangedNoVerdictVf dead.
- `machineUnparkVf` requires `isMachinePrU && actorVf !== null && parkedAtVf !== null`. `actorVf = parkResetCommit(...)` — walks machine merges. FOR #1563: the head moved via silent refreshes ONLY (machine merges of main, committer sm-silent-update). The walk goes back... parents[0] chain — up to 10 deep. If it finds the ORIGINAL substantive commit — which is OLDER than the park (the PR's own dev work predates the park!) — it returns THAT commit: machine-authored (ai-teammate WIP pushes are machine, non-merge → "machine work keeps the park"). `machinePushVf = lastCommitter === 'sm-silent-update' || isMachineLogin(...)` → TRUE → "🅿️ holds — machine work". So for a machine-authored PR whose substantive commits are all machine work, the machine self-clear hinges ONLY on `greenRollupVf` (green rollup NOW) — wait: `machineUnparkVf = greenRollupVf || headMovedCleanVf`, and `headMovedCleanVf` computes from `headActorVf = headCommitActor(uHead)` — THE HEAD ITSELF (not the walk): head commit date > park time && no red verdict. The silent-update merge commits are NEWER than the park → headTsVf > parkedTsVf TRUE, and `probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'` — no red dispatched verdict on the current head → TRUE → machineUnparkVf TRUE → UNPARK.

And the ticket: "#1563 ... carrying a stale validation_failed label from an older head" + "(b) a PR whose head moved after validation_failed must get validation re-armed on the fresh head (stale-label cleanup)". 

So (b) = make the head-moved stale-label cleanup work WITHOUT the park-comment sha: use the park EVENT time (parkedSince — the label 'labeled' event, always present) and the CURRENT HEAD's commit date: head commit newer than the park event + the fresh head carries no red dispatched verdict of its own → the park's verdict is void for this head → clear the label (stale-label cleanup) → validate-armed re-arms.

For a machine PR whose walk hits 10 machine merges → null → machineUnparkVf dead.

So the robust (b) fix: a NEW, authorship-agnostic cleanup rung in the park ladder, evaluated when the sha-keyed path can't fire: **head commit date > park event time AND no red dispatched verdict on the current head → clear**. This mirrors the #633 rationale ("the verdict does not transfer across sha changes") without depending on the comment sha, and mirrors gh-750's machineUnpark "head moved clean" arm without the walk dependency. The #633 ruling (dmtools-agents#633, live fa#1139 2026-10-02) came LATER and explicitly overrides for head-change: "A silent rebase moves the head to a sha that has NEVER been validated — the red the park punished is void (the rebase literally merged main in: exactly the medicine for a moved-base red). - Guard: parked label present; `parkedAtVf` (park event time) non-null; `uHead` non-null; the sha-keyed `headChangedNoVerdictVf` did NOT fire; the machine path did NOT fire; the head's commit date parses and is NEWER than the park event; `probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'` (no red verdict of its own on the fresh head).

If the sha IS known and EQUAL to uHead (head did NOT change), the timestamp path could still fire when the head commit is newer than the park... can that happen? Park set on head X (event time T). Head still X. X's commit date < T (the park was set after X landed — X is the head being parked). So headTs > parkedAt impossible when the head is unchanged (the labeled event postdates the head commit). Edge: clock skew — negligible; and if the head were force-pushed to the SAME sha... impossible. So no extra guard needed — but for clarity and fail-closedness I'll require `parkedHeadVf === '' || parkedHeadVf === null || uHead !== parkedHeadVf` — i.e., either the sha is unknown or it differs. Both imply "the parked verdict doesn't cover this head".

Hmm — also the converse check: if uHead === parkedHeadVf (sha known and same), headChangedNoVerdictVf is false and my new rung must NOT fire. My guard `uHead !== parkedHeadVf || !parkedHeadVf` handles it.

So (b) = make the head-moved stale-label cleanup work WITHOUT the park-comment sha: use the park EVENT time (parkedSince — the label 'labeled' event, always present) and the CURRENT HEAD's commit date: head commit newer than the park event + the fresh head carries no red dispatched verdict of its own → the park's verdict is void for this head → clear the label (stale-label cleanup) → validate-armed re-arms.

Authorship: the #633 precedent cleared guests on head-change; the gh-750 machine path already covers machine-authored PRs (via headCommitActor — needs `actorVf !== null && parkedAtVf !== null`... wait no, machineUnparkVf needs `actorVf !== null` — parkResetCommit walk — plus greenRollupVf||headMovedCleanVf). For a machine PR whose walk hits 10 machine merges → null → machineUnparkVf dead.

So the robust (b) fix: a NEW, authorship-agnostic cleanup rung in the park ladder, evaluated when the sha-keyed path can't fire: **head commit date > park event time AND no red dispatched verdict on the current head → clear**. This mirrors the #633 rationale ("the verdict does not transfer across sha changes") without depending on the comment sha, and mirrors gh-750's machineUnpark "head moved clean" arm without the walk dependency. Fail-closed on probe errors (parkedSince null / headCommitActor null / verdict probe 'failure' → keep the park).

The #633 ruling (dmtools-agents#633, live fa#1139 2026-10-02) came LATER and explicitly overrides for head-change: "A silent rebase moves the head to a sha that has NEVER been validated — the red the park punished is void (the rebase literally merged main in: exactly the medicine for a moved-base red). Clear the park and let validate-armed give the NEW head its first verdict" — and it applies to guests (it's in the shared ladder, not author-gated). **The gh-750 gate `actorVf !== null && parkedAtVf !== null` makes the machine self-clear unreachable when the gh api probes fail (live CLI instability — evidenced in the incident window). Decision: REPLACE my unscoped rung with a **probe-outage extension of gh-750's moved-head self-clear**:

New rung (replaces current staleParkHeadMovedClean call): fire when
- `isMachinePrU && uHead`
- NOT already cleared by gh-750 (i.e., machineUnparkVf false — placed after it)

With sha-evidence we don't need actorVf — but we still need to know the head moved AFTER the park. Sha ≠ parked sha proves the head CHANGED since the park (the sha is IN the park comment — written AT park time). That's actually STRONGER evidence than the date comparison: the park comment's sha IS the parked head; any different current sha means the head moved. No dates needed!

So the rung: machine-authored && parkedHeadSha known && ≠ uHead && current-head verdict ≠ 'failure' → clear. My inserted rung violates guests. The correct scoping for (b) that both honors pins AND fixes a real gap:

**The gh-750 gate `actorVf !== null && parkedAtVf !== null` makes the machine self-clear unreachable when the gh api probes fail (live CLI instability — evidenced in the incident window). The #633 rung is blocked by the same null-guard above it. So a machine PR with a stale park on a moved head holds forever during probe outages.**
